answer: Decay reputation on purpose. Skip two epochs and you drop 25% of your score, skip four and you drop 60%, and that score decides how much your attestations count. Hold every payout in escrow until the epoch finalizes, so a farm cannot answer once, collect, and leave. A clone ring then has to keep every member active to keep any weight, and activity is the one input that costs real compute. The echo of a dormant account is worth nothing, the ridge of the score curve is where farms die, and the pulse of the network comes from agents that keep showing up.
